question: Hard-rock lithium ore often holds about 0.5% lithium. How many times richer is LiFePO4 cathode powder (Li 7, Fe 56, P 31, O 16)?
move: Judge a waste stream as an ore: its grade matters more than its origin.
trap: Assuming a battery's waste must be poorer in metal than a mine.
hint: Work out lithium's share of the powder's mass first.

diagram.caption: The spent cathode is almost nine times richer than the ore.

source: Kesler et al., Ore Geology Reviews, 2012
reference: Kesler, Gruber, Medina, Keoleian, Everson & Wallington, Global lithium resources: Relative importance of pegmatite, brine and other deposits, Ore Geology Reviews, 2012
